name: Essential Artificials
summary: In Ironforge, Klockmort Spannerspan needs components left behind in Gnomeregan. The exiled gnomes fled their city during the trogg invasion and radiation disaster, leaving supplies of essential artificials in its lower halls.

sections.title: Forgotten in the Exodus
sections.body: When troggs overran Gnomeregan and radiation filled its corridors, fleeing gnomes carried only what they could reach. Supplies of essential artificials remained behind. These specialized mechanical parts work in nearly any device, and tinkers and crafters prize them. Now based in Ironforge's Tinker Town, master tinker Klockmort Spannerspan cannot continue his new experiments without them.

sections.title: Delving the Extrapolators
sections.body: The components are kept in heavy, steam-powered containers called artificial extrapolators, deep inside Gnomeregan. Reaching them means crossing irradiated halls where mutated leper gnomes, malfunctioning defense automatons, and feral troggs roam. Klockmort needs twelve components to continue his work and keep gnomish invention moving despite the exile.

faq.answer: An essential artificial is a mechanical component made by gnomish engineers that works in nearly any device. Tinkers and smiths value these parts as building blocks for complex contraptions and experimental machinery.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Essential Artificials?
aliases: where do i get essential artificials
faq.answer: Klockmort Spannerspan, a gnomish engineer in Ironforge's Tinker Town, gives this assignment.

faq.q: Where are the essential artificials found in Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: The essential artificials are kept deep in Gnomeregan in artificial extrapolators, tall, steam-powered storage cabinets scattered through the lower halls.

faq.q: Why were they left behind in Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Troggs invaded Gnomeregan, and radiation flooded the city. In the sudden evacuation, the gnomes left stocks of essential artificials in the lower workshops.

faq.q: What does Klockmort need them for?
faq.answer: Klockmort Spannerspan needs a supply of the components for complex experiments he is preparing in his Ironforge workshop.

faq.q: Is Klockmort's Essentials required before taking this quest?
faq.answer: Klockmort's Essentials introduces you to Klockmort and points you to his workshop, but you can accept this assignment without completing it.

angles.text: As a gnome, recovering these components helps preserve your people's craft and invention during exile in Ironforge.
As an engineer, you know how much work can halt for want of one part. These components show the skill of Gnomeregan's engineers before the city fell.
As an Alliance member, helping the exiled gnomes recover their lost technology strengthens the Alliance's engineering base in Ironforge.
